Resolves #19666

`examples/grid/contentSizedRows` shows 10k records whose wrapped texts size their rows in the start, center and end bodies, with a toolbar toggle back to fixed 32px rows as the control. `ContentSizedRowsExample.spec.mjs` turns D#19645's ten required examples into named e2e tests against the browser's layout: a row needs its tallest text plus the cell's chrome. It adds a wheel-throughput measurement. The journey found two engine defects, fixed and merged in #19695 and #19699. Linux CI found a third, fixed here with one flag in `src/grid/View.mjs`: #19663's hidden measuring cells kept the 1px right border that a region's last column drops.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e on the example and a two-view fixture, in CI's engine e2e job) → L3 required (AC-2 is an e2e, AC-3 a measured run). No residuals.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: "10. the fixed-height control keeps every row at rowHeight" checks the toggle. The extent is `(10000 + 1) × 32` and every row is 32px at its index, at two offsets. Toggled back, the rows fit their text. All tests except 9 (two views, on its fixture) run on the 10k example, which wraps in all three bodies. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ContentSizedRowsExample.spec.mjs`, one test per example, each titled with its number 1–10. Example 2 has two tests (width, font), example 3 three (edit, sort, filter). |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI: the table under Test Evidence. CI runs the test, but the numbers live in its annotations. |
| AC-4 | The epic review's evidence matrix (#19658, [comment 6125933235](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19658#issuecomment-6125933235)) fills columns 4–6, edited in place. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The example edits summaries in place and filters them, for example 3. Example 9 uses a fixture, `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-two-views`: one store at 400px and 900px.
- Test 6 releases its thumb drag mid-list. At the end of the list, rows from the top edge down that shrink at the release must move that edge's row, since a view cannot scroll past its end. Since #19663 the drag starts with the measured mean instead of the 32px floor, so they do shrink there (5/5 red at the end, 5/5 green mid-list).
- The hidden projection passes `isLastColumn`, as `Row#createVdom` does. Without it, the last column of each region was measured with the 1px right border its displayed cell drops (`neo-last-column`). Under Arial metrics, which Linux CI's fallback font shares, record 4's details wrapped to three lines hidden and two shown. CI's test 1 caught it: row 4 went 62 → 43 when the column mounted. A unit test in `PremeasureRows.spec.mjs` compares a hidden cell's classes with its displayed cell's.
- The e2e reads only rows of the visible pool, never #19663's hidden measuring rows (`.neo-grid-row-measure`).

## Test Evidence
Wheel throughput, 3 runs with the sampler of `430f7f3087`, each 40 steps of 100px over unseen rows after 5 unsampled warm-up steps. Arrivals exclude the rows present when sampling starts, and a view at rest is the control: no arrivals. A row arrives at the estimate when the App Worker's geometry did not know its height yet in that frame, read from a clock on `RowGeometry#setHeights`. Probe 6 is D#19645's fixed-height baseline: `examples/grid/bigData`, 32px rows, the same wheel inputs.

| | Probe 6 (fixed 32px) | This example (content-sized, ≈87px mean) |
|---|---|---|
| Rows entering per second, ordinary (100px / 50ms) | 41 | 14–16 |
| Rows entering per second, fast (100px / 16ms) | 71 | 21–23 |
| Frames over 20ms | 0 | 0, max 17ms |
| Main-thread measuring | 1.5–2.6 ms/s (derived) | 1–2 ms/s (measured) |
| Newly mounted at the estimate, ordinary / fast | — | 0 of 42–45 / 21–23 of 49–54 |
| Newly visible at the estimate, ordinary / fast | — | 0 / 0 |

At fast input, measure-ahead lags the buffer: about 40% of the rows mounted ahead of the view arrive at the estimate. All of them are measured before they scroll into view. At the same wheel input, rows entering per second fall with row height. Probe 6's 50–80ms scroll-to-fresh-rows latency is not an AC metric and was not re-measured.

**The border fix, swept over fonts.** Before it, test 1's mount step changed one row each under Arial, Georgia and Verdana by one line (Arial: record 4, 62 → 43). With it, no row changes under five fonts, 2 runs each. The new unit test is red without the fix: the hidden cell lacks `neo-last-column`.

**Red controls.** On `dev` before #19688 merged, two tests fail: "1. an initially unmounted tallest column sizes its rows before it mounts" (row 1 changed when the details column mounted), and "2. a font that arrives after the first measurement re-measures the rows" (record 1 at 100px against 119px). So both witness #19663's measure-ahead. Example 4 holds the first in-place read after a jump until its rows show other records. With the reply fence's record and cell checks both removed, it fails 3/3: 10 recycled records change height. Either check alone still holds it.

## Post-Merge Validation
- None: every AC is met at this head.

## Commits
- `439fae5e8e`, `5f6fabe132` — the example, then in-place editing and a filter.
- `213f4b17c7` — the ten examples as named tests, plus the two-view fixture.
- `23a4b41a20`, `f14de66956`, `3fb6a46fb9` — integration with #19663: visible-pool reads, end check and edit locator, estimate shares only when classifying.
- `c0f35261d7`, `0446257609` — scroll precision past 2^23px, then 10k records, which keep positions whole.
- `429c4c8fe0`, `550fc6ec88`, `7a8ba75560` — settle requires a row at the top edge; the sampler warms up; the thumb drag releases mid-list.
- `d209dfc7bc` — hidden measuring cells drop their region's last right border, as displayed cells do.
- `430f7f3087` — the sampler reads the estimate from the worker's geometry; example 4 holds a real read across recycling.

## Evolution
- 100k → 10k: past 2^23px, Chrome rounds scroll offsets to 2px ([#19658 comment 6134339160](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19658#issuecomment-6134339160)), and browsers cap element heights differently (operator, 2026-10-12).
